# Release preparation

1. Confirm release scope, target repositories, versioning convention, and release authority. Read each repository's current release documentation.
2. Derive release notes from merged changes and verified user-facing impact. Do not invent fixes or omit known breaking changes.
3. Update only requested version/changelog files and follow the repository's established format. Use document-organization for new documents.
4. Validate release notes and version consistency with available repository checks.
5. Report proposed contents and publication steps. Do not tag, publish, deploy, or transition Jira unless explicitly authorized.
